data.value: Will the United Auto Workers Local 1012 ratify the proposed contract with AutoParts Inc. by the strike deadline of September 5?

The proposed contract between UAW Local 1012 and AutoParts Inc. is on the table. A ratification vote is scheduled before the strike deadline of September 5, 2026. If the contract is not ratified by then, a strike may occur.
